description: White canvas; light-grey rounded box upper-left/centre with black serif text 'Q. If every human somehow simply disappeared from the face of the earth, how long would it be before the last artificial light source would go out? - Alan'. Lower-left: large black-ink stick figure holding a sheet of paper. Lower-right: dark-grey textured panel with a small shaded-head stick figure and a lit table lamp with white glow.
Black ink of both stick figures and the paper turns red/crimson over the activity frames (f61 black -> f64 partly red -> f66 red); lamp and panel unchanged.
Same layout as opening but both stick figures drawn in red ink; lamp lit; question box unchanged.
Red outlines of the large figure and the small figure break up into scattered red dots; the held paper fades to a grey outline and becomes a black-outlined page at lower-left. Lamp still lit.
Large figure and small figure rendered as red particle outlines (disintegrating); black-outlined paper lower-left; lamp still lit; question box unchanged.
Lamp glow and the grey panel brightness fade down; panel becomes darker grey and lamp is unlit by f156. Particle figures unchanged.
Dark-grey panel with unlit lamp; particle-red figures; paper lower-left; question box upper-left.

Hard cut at f208 from the question scene to a red title card: black dinosaur-on-satellite illustration upper-middle; white text 'xkcd's' above large 'what if?' and 'THE VIDEO SERIES' below. Held about 2 s with no visible change in tiles; by f256 a second hard cut to a black/grey skyline (onset between f246 and f256 UNRESOLVED).
Night skyline in grey/black with many lit white windows on left buildings, small stars and a curved chimney smoke wisp upper-left; right half of canvas solid black.
All lit windows dim from white to grey and then to dark; buildings become flat silhouettes.
Dark silhouette skyline, no lit windows; right half black.

Single-frame appearance in the right half of a lit grey living-room panel: wall-mounted air conditioner with wind lines, ceiling lamp, TV, armchair, nightstand with lava lamp, fridge with magnets; a red-outlined stick figure sits in the chair already breaking into particles. Skyline unchanged on left.
Skyline left; lit room panel right with TV, armchair, nightstand with lava lamp, fridge, AC; the seated figure is gone. Small residual pixel drift only.
Hard cut to white canvas with black silhouette coal power plant: tall smokestack with outlined smoke clouds upper-left, coal hopper tower with conveyor left, blocky buildings, crane right.
Coal plant silhouette on white: smokestack with outlined smoke, hopper tower and conveyor, buildings, crane at right.
Single-frame pop-on of a black electricity pylon with outlined wires at the right edge of the plant.
Coal plant with pylon at right; no truck or coal pile.
Single-frame pop-on of a black dump truck loaded with coal at left and a large coal pile in front of the hopper tower.
Coal plant with truck at far left, coal pile, hopper, smokestack, buildings, pylon right.

Tiny red stick figures appear over the activity frames at the plant base: first a small red mark in the truck cab (f627), then red figures by the hopper (two) and by the building (three) and one by the pylon (f630-f633).
Plant silhouette with the tiny red figures already shown as particle outlines (disintegrating); smoke and pylon unchanged.
Red particle figures fade out and the outlined smoke clouds fade from black outline to grey to nothing across the activity frames; plant silhouette remains.
Plant silhouette with truck, coal pile, pylon; no smoke, no figures.

Hard cut to white canvas: standing black stick figure left; framed wall map upper-right with small line icons (nuclear plant, power plants, pylons, city, ship, solar panels, wind turbines) and one black warning triangle; two seated people at consoles lower-right.
Control room: stick figure left, wall map with icons in black/grey and a warning triangle top-centre, two seated operators at consoles.
Map icons fade from black to grey while the warning triangle stays black; people and figure unchanged.
Control room with map icons in grey except black warning triangle top-centre.
Single-frame pop-on of hand-lettered speech label 'UH OH...' with a short tick line above the standing figure's head.
Same room with 'UH OH...' label next to the standing figure.
Standing figure and both operators turn red and begin breaking into particles; 'UH OH...' label fades out.
Three people drawn as red particle outlines; map with grey icons and one black warning triangle.
Single-frame pop-on of a second black warning triangle at the upper-left of the map (over the nuclear icon).
Map with two warning triangles (upper-left and upper-centre).
Single-frame pop-on of a third warning triangle at the lower-left of the map.
Map with three warning triangles.
Single-frame pop-on of a fourth warning triangle at the lower-centre of the map.
Map with four warning triangles.
Single-frame pop-on of a fifth warning triangle at the lower-right of the map.
Map with five warning triangles.
Single-frame pop-on of a sixth warning triangle at the upper-right of the map.
Map with six warning triangles (three upper row, three lower row); particle people.
Whole canvas fades from white through grey to dark charcoal over six frames; map and particle figures remain visible but dimmed.
Dim dark-grey canvas with the map, triangles and particle figures barely visible.

Hard cut to white canvas with black nuclear plant silhouette: cooling tower with outlined smoke left, reactor dome with glowing white core and radiation symbol, turbine in outline, pylon right; three small red stick figures.
Nuclear plant: cooling tower, reactor with glowing core, turbine, pylon, smoke; three small red stick figures near the tower, reactor and turbine.
The three small red figures break into red particles.
Nuclear plant with red particle figures; core glowing.

Hard cut to a bar chart on white: left panel titled 'FUEL ENERGY CONTENT IN MJ/KG' with short underlined bars labelled 19 SUGAR, 24 COAL, 39 FAT, 46 GASOLINE and URANIUM; a very tall black uranium bar loops up and winds off to the right ending at a tiny stick figure. No number beside the figure yet.
Fuel energy chart with 19/24/39/46 values, tall uranium bar looping to a tiny stick figure at right end; no figure label.
Hand-lettered '76,000,000' types on above the tiny figure at the end of the bar, with a short curved tick line: '76,0' -> '76,000,' -> '76,000,000' across the activity frames.
Chart with '76,000,000' label above the tiny figure.
Hard cut back to the nuclear plant silhouette with glowing core, smoke and pylon; red figures absent.
Nuclear plant, glowing core, smoke; slight pixel drift only.
Single-frame appearance of several tiny white-outlined devices/indicators on the reactor dome, cooling tower, turbine and generator; unreadable at tile scale.
Nuclear plant with tiny white indicator devices, glowing core, smoke.
Outlined smoke fades to grey then disappears; the core's white glow dims to grey.
Nuclear plant with no smoke and unlit grey core; tiny indicator devices still white.
Single-frame appearance of small glowing red dots at the indicator devices on the dome, tower, turbine and generator.
Nuclear plant with red alarm dots; no smoke; grey core.
Single-frame pop-on of speech label 'MAYDAY!' with a curved tick toward the pylon at right.
Nuclear plant with red alarm dots and 'MAYDAY!' label right of the dome.

Hard cut to a 2x2 grid of grey panels each with a hanging lit bulb: upper-left geothermal pipe plant (black), upper-right diesel generator, lower-left house with solar roof, lower-right two wind turbines.
Four-panel grid, all four bulbs lit.
Upper-left (geothermal) panel's bulb light goes out; panel darkens.
Upper-left panel dark; other three bulbs lit.
Upper-right (diesel generator) panel goes dark.
Upper panels dark; lower two lit.
Lower-left (solar house) panel goes dark.
Only lower-right (wind turbine) panel lit.
Lower-right (wind) panel goes dark; all four panels dark.
All four panels dark grey with unlit bulbs.
Hard cut to a dark-grey night scene: island hump with thatched hut (lit doorway and window), diesel generator left of hut, black palm tree, small seated stick figure at right, black waves at bottom.
Island hut scene with lit door and window, generator, palm, seated figure.
Hut door and window glow go out; seated figure turns red and starts to particulate.
Dark island scene, unlit hut, red particle seated figure.
Single-frame pop-on of white label '< 6 MONTHS' upper-left.
Dark island scene with '< 6 MONTHS' label upper-left.

Hard cut to white canvas with five line-drawing icons: AA-style battery (left), two wind turbines (centre), solar panel (right), geothermal/turbine house with pipe (lower-left), hydro pipe/dam structure (lower-right).
Five-icon line-drawing layout on white: battery, two wind turbines, solar panel, turbine house, hydro structure.

Geothermal plant silhouette with steam, turbine in white outline, pylon.

Geothermal plant with two-line label upper-centre.

Hard cut to a black silhouette field of wind turbines of varied sizes on white.
Wind turbine silhouette field on white.
Single-frame pop-on of a video-call style window upper-centre showing a helmeted stick figure and caption 'Tom Scott' with a verified badge, with a curved tick line toward a turbine.
Wind field with video-call window upper-centre.
Hard cut to white canvas: small black Gedser turbine silhouette at left with label 'GEDSER WIND TURBINE, DENMARK' above it; thin vertical divider; right area blank.
Gedser turbine silhouette left with label; divider; right blank.
Single-frame pop-on of label '11 YEARS' above the Gedser label.
Left panel with '11 YEARS' and Gedser turbine.
Single-frame pop-on of a middle panel with a black three-blade modern turbine silhouette and a new divider.
Two panels: Gedser (left) and modern turbine (middle).
Single-frame pop-on of label '3 YEARS' above the middle turbine.
Two panels with labels '11 YEARS' and '3 YEARS'.

Three turbine panels; labels over first two.
Single-frame pop-on of label '>20 YEARS' above the third turbine.
Three panels labelled '11 YEARS', '3 YEARS', '>20 YEARS'.
Single-frame pop-on of a white inset box over the third turbine's tower showing a black nacelle with a glowing white dot (status LED), connected by a curved line to the hub.
Three turbine panels with nacelle inset showing black nacelle and glowing white dot.
Inset nacelle's black fill fades through grey to a white cutaway showing a drivetrain/gearbox outline, over six frames.
Three panels; inset shows white-filled nacelle cutaway with gearbox line drawing.

Three panels; inset gearbox with small damage marks.
Hard cut to a dam cross-section: grey reservoir with fish at left, black dam wall with pipe channel, tiny stick figure at the top beside a control booth, turbine housing and pylon right.
Dam cross-section with tiny figure at top, reservoir left, pylon right.
Single-frame pop-on of speech label 'I DON'T ACTUALLY DO ANYTHING HERE' from the tiny figure.
Dam with speech label from tiny figure.
Pale grey label 'OOPS!' fades in near the pylon while the figure's speech label fades out and the tiny figure turns red/particulates.
Dam with black 'OOPS!' label near pylon; red particle figure at top; no speech label.
Label '~4 YEARS' fades in upper-left while 'OOPS!' fades out; the dam channel/intake area near the turbine gains dark speckled damage and debris.
Dam with '~4 YEARS' label, speckled damage at the intake and channel; no 'OOPS!'.
Hard cut to a light-grey vignette scene with a box poster: bulb icon and hand-lettered 'Eternal LIGHT Requires infinity AA Batteries (not included)' over rows of black battery icons.
Eternal Light box with rows of full black batteries on light-grey background.
Background and box fade from light grey to dark charcoal over six frames.
Dim dark-grey frame with the Eternal Light box barely visible.
Hard cut to a drawer seen from the front: white drawer with a pen, two dice and two red AA batteries; grey desk, white wall above.
Open drawer with pen, dice, two AA batteries filled red in halves.
Red fill in the two batteries drains from red to pink to white over six frames.
Drawer with two empty white batteries.
Hard cut to six red-filled battery icons with labels: LEAD-ACID, ALKALINE, ZINC CARBON (top row), NI-MH, NI-CD, LITHIUM-ION (bottom row).
Six full red batteries with labels.

Six battery icons all white/empty except small red residue in lithium-ion; labels shown. Pixel drift indicates the draining continued during hold.
Hard cut to white canvas with a house with a solar-panel roof at upper-left; rest blank.
Solar-roof house at left; blank right.
Single-frame pop-on of a divider and a second panel with a weather station on a pole with solar panel.
Two panels: house, weather station.
Single-frame pop-on of a third panel: fenced compound with razor wire, security camera and solar panel on a block.
Three panels: house, weather station, fenced compound with camera. Encoder-artifact frames flagged during hold.

Night road scene with sign, bushes and lit solar pole; long hold.
Single-frame change to a close-up of the solar panel on a pole and the lamp at the bottom on dark grey; could be a zoom of the previous scene but no intermediate frames.
Close-up of solar panel on pole with lamp at lower-left.

Close-up solar panel with cable to lamp.

Solar panel with grime and corroded pole.

Road scene with billboard, tumbleweed, lit pole.

Road scene with '~100 YEARS' label.

Road scene with rain streaks and '~100 YEARS' label.

Five lit panels in a row.

Strip with barrel panel at right, solar panel lit.

Glowing white barrel with trefoil on dark grey.

Dim unlit barrel with trefoil on dark grey.

Barrel with three radiation warning signs around it.

Watch with glowing numerals, concentric grey rings.

Watch with rings and painter figure at lower-right.

Tank cross-section cropped at left with small circles converging to a dot.

Tank with cyan glow and wavy photon lines.
